name: Simyl Mct Powder 400gm
introduction:
Introduction About SIMYL MCT POWDER

Simyl Mct Powder is an infant milk substitute that restores general health in infants suffering from severe diarrhea. It offers a balanced nutrition to infants without causing stomach problems and contributes to maintain overall growth and development in babies.

It contains various multivitamins and multimineral along with taurine, choline, L-carnitine and omega-3 and-6 fatty acids that helps in proper growth and development of brain, heart, bones and muscles. They also enhance memory and cognitive functions, supports healthy eyes, and regulate proper metabolism and replaces sufficient nutrients to the body.

Simyl Mct Powder should be used under careful medical supervision. It is lactose and sucrose free, therefore suitable for use among infant intolerant to sugars.

Refer to the feeding guide available with the product and measure the quantity of powder to be taken for preparation. Only use the measuring cup provided with the pack for measuring the powder.

Take the required amount of Simyl Mct Powder in a sterilized utensil. Add few teaspoons of lukewarm water into the powder and gently mix without lumps. Refer to the feeding guide and add the correct volume of water and mix until it forms a smooth paste.

Reconstituted Simyl Mct Powder mixture must be consumed within half of hour. Simyl Mct Powder must only be prepared fresh just before feeding the baby. Do not refrigerate or store the mixture for later use, as it increases the risk of infections.

While feeding the baby, make sure to sterilize the feeding utensils by placing them in boiling water for 5 minutes and only use boiled, cooled water for reconstitution.

Strictly follow the dosing schedule as mentioned in the tin or package. Do not add few scoops of powder or less water than directed as it may not provide adequate nutrients to the baby. Similarly, do not add more scoops than directed as it makes the feed more concentrated than desired.
author: Srilekha. R

name: Simyl Mct Oil 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About SIMYL MCT OIL 100ML

Simyl MCT Oil is a nutritional formula used for general growth and good health. It contains MCT oil and tocopherol acetate (antioxidant) as active ingredients that help in growth and development.

Medium-chain triglycerides (MCT) act as a nutritional source of energy that helps the body to function properly in processes such as digestion, absorption, distribution, and metabolism. Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant, has a role in anti-inflammatory processes and inhibition of platelet aggregation and has immune-enhancing activity.

Always use Simyl MCT Oil exactly as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Ask your doctor before taking it during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SIMYL MCT OIL 100ML

Consult a doctor if you experience any unusual side effects while taking Simyl MCT Oil.
